purpose: Prepare a small, high-confidence official-source batch while the existing single shared runner refreshes. No queue task or parallel runner is created by this artifact.

geometry_source.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
geometry_source.use_rule: Use the monthly England and Wales freehold polygon dataset only to shortlist the indicative registered-property extent near the official address. Confirm the building or centre footprint and exclude adjacent parcels before binding.
geometry_source.legal_boundary_warning: INSPIRE polygons show position and indicative extent; this preparation does not claim an exact legal title boundary.

candidates.geometry_next_step: Shortlist INSPIRE freehold polygons around W12 7SL, compare them with the shopping-centre footprint, and exclude car parks or the wider White City estate unless separately supported.
